items.description: Treemily is an online family tree builder that helps users create diverse visualizations of their family. The platform is free for all basic functionality and family tree designs, with paid membership options available for access to more robust customization options. Users can purchase the designs as downloads or ready made prints, from posters to framed canvases. Since the tree builder templates are the key novelty of the Treemily platform, users can simply import their existing lineage as a GEDCOM file, and generate visualizations.

Weglore is a location based photo sharing app that allows users to explore the globe with map navigation and photo markers. The photo series incorporates smart social functions that enable filtering of unwanted photos and sharing photos pertaining to a similar subject. The Weglore mobile app users geolocation to add metadata to photos, and enables users to subscribe to photos aggregated to a particular location, with optional notification settings as well as other functions. The app is free and can be downloaded for Android from Google Play.

Flixster provides services for discovering, collecting, and watching movies and TV programs. Users can create a profile and store movie ratings, favorites, lists, and more. Users can connect their profile with friends, and discover, purchase and view a variety of content. The services offered from Flixster can be integrated with social media platforms and other applications.
Payment app powered by LevelUpâ€™s API leveraging the Pebble Smartwatch.
eBooksDoc brings together a community of word lovers. In our site you will be able to find any kind of documents and official manuals (pdf, txt, word, ppt, etc), books and eBooks.

Create a personalised dashboard of line charts to keep an eye on the UK economy. The page uses a PHP script to scrape time-series data CSVs from the Office for National Statistics website each day and add them to a MySQL database. Two more PHP scripts provide data to the page in JSON format.
A fun game to play with your friends: we randomly choose one of your Instagram photos, they choose the most appropriate song for it.

Rentenna leveraged the BlockAvenue API to pull down local Block Reviews about nearby streets and neighborhoods and mashed it up on their property detail pages to help people who are looking to rent an apartment
Passione non profit is an Italian site. It appears to be an aggregate of non profit blog posts.

AllMusic by Rovi takes the best of AllMusic.com and packages it into a convenient app for mobile music discovery. AllMusic lets you tailor your experience, offering personalized recommendations based on music you already like.

TweepsMap analyzes where your Twitter followers are from, groups them by country, state or city and plots them on a Google map. Visualize data as a list or pie chart and share your reports with followers.
allSongsBy provides full song listings for any artist via YouTube's vast free music collection. Lists are organized by artist and album.
Simple surveys to share with friends through Twitter, sms or email. Anywhere you can paste text, you can give a wedgie (a simple survey).
This mashup provides analytics for any three twitter handles.

Infinilla shows 3 random picks from Dribbble using its API. You can click the refresh link on the bottom of the page and get 3 randomly chosen images that you can use for inspiration. If you want to get more info about the image you see, just click on it and you will get to the page of that image on Dribbble.

Grabbing trends from Google, Twitter, Yahoo! & YouTube and aggregating them into a single site. View trend snapshots (taken about every 45 min.), or blended into a daily wordcloud visualization to see relative trend popularity for the day.
With this App you can synchronize your Google Contacts to be part of you network on Tradeshift
bookfriend is an Android application which creates companion guides for any book instantly and seamlessly wherever you are.
AccentTraining.net is a mashup of Twilio, Amazon Mechanical Turk and Recurly APIs to create an accent rating and training service. Create a recording and have it rated by real American residents.
TodoToday for Voo2do is a simple task manager application to show only the current due and overdue tasks from Voo2do.com.
A picturesque look at the world’s best motorcycle roads.
Connected is a personal relationship manager that brings your contacts and conversations together from email, social networks, calendar and phone.
A website which provides deal tracking and price analysis for outdoor gear. Offers a price history and price comparison tool, as well as email and text alerts.
Searches the iPhone/iPad App Store using the iTunes API. Provides instant search feedback with top apps, including their large icons. Created by people behind App of the Day site.

A social network to share photos. It collects automatically all your photos and contacts from Facebook, Flickr and Picasa and allows you to share your photos with your friends whatever their website is.

This map and table application displays historical and cultural monuments in Los Angeles, with a focus on monuments that celebrate diversity, democracy, and freedom. Includes descriptions and Flickr photos for over 900 monuments.

Maiana is a social service to host, explore and share Topic Maps sources. Maiana provides mashups to deliver the structured content into blogs and other CMS. For enforcing semantic interoperability subj3ct.com is used.
CrocTail provides an interface for browsing information parsed from SEC filings about several hundred thousand U.S. publicly traded corporations and their foreign subsidiaries.
Allows Box.net users to share content in their Box accounts to FriendFeed.
Create your own maps and share with friends.
Social Actions aggregates actions from more than 60 sources including from WiserEarth, using the WiserEarth API.

OggChat is a live chat solution for website support and sales that integrates with Google Talk and GMail. It incorporates features such as custom chat windows and skills based routing, but routes all chats directly to each operator's Google Talk acc

GeoFeeling geolocates feelings of bloggers on the map, making use of APIs: Google Maps and WeFeelFine which has been harvesting human emotions from a large number of weblogs: LiveJournal, MSN Spaces, MySpace, Blogger, Technorati, Feedster and Google.

The Twitter Instant Speed Meter. TweeSpeed is a web service giving you the number of tweets sent in the last minute. TweeSpeed is based on the public timeline, grab information for the 5 last minutes and calculate an average speed for one minute.
An interactive African tourist guide providing rich interactive content. Built using Microsoft Silverlight along with Google Maps.

A dashboard to track, both geographically and timewise, the spread of the 2009 swine flu (AKA influenza H1N1). It uses a combination of three Google Visualization gadgets linked between each other. Also uses Google Elements.
Tracks micro-trends on twitter and brand user satisfaction. See metrics visualized using Google Visualization API.
Daily Bible readings mashed up with personalized journaling.
Produces graphs of how often things are mentioned on guardian.co.uk.
An Adobe Flash and Adobe AIR application that uses color themes from kuler to draw patterns. It also draws at dimensions defined by the user which can be used for wallpapers etc.
Interactive pie chart that allows you to select and compare two countries energy production by energy source: fossil, nuclear, hydro or renewable. Data is from Carma.org.
Find interactive data graphs for top countries leading in energy production from renewable, hydro, nuclear and fossil energy sources. Data is from carma.org.
Ever wanted to see all your Google Contacts on a map? With the Google Contacts Map you can easily do so.

A Web-based reader for FriendFeed that displays your feed in the left frame. Web sites referenced in the feed are displayed on the right. See what your friends are linking to. AJAX interface auto-refreshes your feed. Implemented on Google App Engine.
Spying on FriendFeed public timeline in real time and more.
Track the most popular news and other threads online via RSSmeme. Integrates with FriendFeed API.

Tracks the FriendFeed public feed to show statistics about FriendFeed. Shows data in a variety of formats in hours, days, months, or services, and allows you to drill down to a specific user or service.
The BigOven Cookbook is a fast and simple way to gather and publish family or group recipe collections, including those that may be spread across multiple users around the world.
Uses the data from BookMooch, LibraryThing and Amazon to display the most wanted and most available books at BookMooch.

An official Google Gadget to demonstrate the Visualization API. A dynamic flash based chart to explore several indicators over time. Required columns: bubble name, time and 2 columns of numeric values.
A mashup using Degrafa drawing library in Flex with the Kuler API. Creates generative compositions via the Flash player.
Whatsikat Boso shows how Filipino bloggers are feeling right now. It extracts feelings from Filipino blogs. Take a peek into their moods and see how that makes you feel.
Create fullscreen generative compositions based on Kuler themes via a Flash interface.
An online language-learning site providing tutoring and coaching for Arabic, French, and Spanish.

CarePages.com allows members to move the content contained on a site including message board comments, updates regarding care and prognosis and photographs into a CarePages Keepsake Book that can be purchased immediately or personalized further.
Find the closest OnAIR bus stop to where you live and the current weather at that location
Find where the nearest Starbucks is for each of the OnAIR bus tour stops.
Map to show you the current location of the Adobe on AIR promotional tour bus.
SharedBook used its API and Google widgets to build Blog2Print, a new blog printing widget that can be used by writers and their readers to turn blog posts into books.

The SharedBook API was used to develop an interface to give the passengers of Regent Seven Seas Cruises the ability to pick and choose content from the specific ports they visited to include in their travel books.

Uses the SharedBook Reverse Publishing Platform, multiple streams of data containing the obituary, guest book entries and family photos automatically flow from Legacy.com to SharedBook where the content is mapped into a structured book product.

Winner of the 2007 ETel Mashup Contest. A clever and useful mashup that transcribes office voice mails left by patients for doctors into text and then sends them via SMS to the doctor. With source code.
10,000 sheep created by online workers. An Amazon Mechanical Turk application. Each worker was paid 2 cents US to draw a sheep facing left. Buy your favorite. Unlike anything before.
Waitlist management built using Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs. Schedule notifications, predefined messages and auto responses. Data analytics galore.
Kitten and cat classifieds. Find kittens for sale and adoption or list your avaialable cats for free.
Song meanings site that allows you to share your personal memories, experiences and interpretations of your favorite songs.
Allows Box.net users to send documents from their Box.net account to FedEx, where they can be printed and shipped.

Track all metrics - CPC CTR, Cost of Conversions etc. - of your Google AdWords campaigns. Analyze clicks, impressions, conversions per campaign and drill down to view the metrics for the groups within a campaign. Works for MCC accounts too.
Search the best product prices, expert reviews and merchant offers online. Compare prices before you buy.
Pinterest is basically a social networking website like other sites such as Twitter, Facebook where any individual can post and share anything that interests people.

devChirp is the best place to find top software developers and designers around the world and take a peek at what they are upto. We cherry pick public twitter profiles and organize them such that it is easy to discover right people.

The Whoop! SaaS solution helps retailers to automatically build the best Google Adwords campaign structure and bidding strategy for their product data feed. Whoop! has a tight integration with Google Adwords and Merchant Center Accounts.
Makes it easy to review and delete/keep your old delicious bookmarks by showing the web page in a n iframe right next to some delete/keep buttons
Creative on-demand print service that lets you turn your Flickr photos from virtual content into physical content like all new Mini Cards.
Joobel search for local jobs. In German.
Uses vk.com (vkontakte.ru), soundcloud.com, ex.fm, last.fm and youtube.com to give you music player and social app.
A history of places at which you checked in by foursquare is shown per a venue/month. It is also possible for the place to show by check-in history with heat maps.

The Udacity iOS App allows users to access Udacity's programming courses from their mobile iOS devices. Using the app, Udacity students can solve programming problems and respond to short quizzes on the go. Classes can be downloaded so that users can still watch them when they don't have internet access.
Find bargains on Amazon.com. Find items by highest percentage off, popularity, rating and bargains.
A sortable, filterable, editable list of the best high schools in America, driven by the Factual Web Apps API.
This mashup takes your top 50 artists and plays random music videos by those artists. It can go full screen and you can play your lastFM friends favorite artists too.

Meedeor gives you a gallery to store and showcase your mobile photography. Post photos via email, text or iPhone app and explore them on your phone or computer. Connect with Facebook and Twitter to share your entries.
Browse the vineyards of Oregon via this comprehensive map. Search by location, varietal or vineyard amenity.
Weather forecast site for Estonia, Scandinavia. The site is in Finnish (Suomalainen).

Weather Center is the weather app that has all the data users will ever need. It tracks general weather including summary and detailed forecasts. It also provides users with information on severe weather including storm reports, NWS watches and warnings, storm cell tracking and more.

Tweaker the Tweet Speaker will speak tweets to you from the global Twitter stream. Listen to tweets as they arrive in six categories from and about some of the most popular users and topics on twitter. Stop reading tweets, and start listening instead.
The FlickrSpy is back. Check out the new 2008 FlickrSpy and watch whats uploaded right now at flickr.
Find quotes from people about arbitrary topics.
Links you to pizzeria reviews at America’s Favorite Pizza Weblog. With fun slice-shaped map markers.

An application that uses Flash to explore Flickr photos via virtual 3D planetary systems. Enter a tag, and the related galaxy appears on screen. When you click on a sun, the images are placed on a 3D rotating globe.

DocuSign for Microsoft is an eSignature application that is integrated with Microsoft Word. The application lets users to review and send documents for signature directly from the MS Office applications that they are using. The recipients are then able to sign the documents electronically using DocuSign.
Risk evolved into massive Google Maps game with 55 million cells and instant action Arena tournaments.
eatbytweet is a restaurant Tweets mashup covering thousands of restaurants across the US. Use eatbytweet to view up-to-the minute restaurant specials and reservation information.
mygoogleplus.com uses Google+ API to transform user profile into a Facebook style timeline.
Basecamp is a project management resource.
Find rideshare matches among craigslist rideshare ads, according to your estimated route. Uses craigslist, Google Maps, and postgres.

Editors have created a unique listening experience for their new album 'In This Light And On This Evening' by augmenting Google Street View with their own custom locations complete with streaming music.

Bontq is a revolutionary bug & issue tracking system. It allows you to manage projects and track bugs very easy because of its clean and user-friendly interface. The essential part of Bontq is it's Desktop Client. Using Desktop Client's functionality you can Capture Screenshots, Record Videos and attach them right to your items.
Use this album maker to build an album and a slideshow of your Flickr photos. It can generate HTML code for you to embed to your blog or web site.
Comment Stack is a mashup of ReadSocial and Readability. Allowing users to quickly reference content across platforms.

Most information available on the internet is not directly consumable by software systems. Information is locked away behind the presentation layer markup or javascript callbacks. Workplace.com provides Targeted Portfolio Analysis, Recorded Document Search, Servicing Research Tasks and other web scraping methods.

Consolidation of information about notable people, including celebrities, musicians, writers, historical figures and sports people. Auto-ranking of people based on density of current news and automatic analysis of connections between people.
Instant map search for local weather and nearest hotels, foods, bars, parking, clinics etc.
iLoveInns is a Bed and Breakfast locator. Search by location or by a region to drill down. It also has gift certificates, a shopping cart, my favorites and other features.
Desktop application for managing photos on the Smugmug service.
This lightweight music search page uses the SNOCAP MySpace Search API to display results along with embeddable Flash player.
dr. Nescio is a application that automatically indexes and ranks cities based on individual sights, like museums, parks, hotels, bars and music venues.
A Google Gadget for website builders. Internet and Web terms, facts, history, events, and knowledge plus everyday tips and advice for building a website, blog or e-commerce site.
Second thought is a dynamic image and text composition. You can choose any words to change the picture or the word. Uses APIs from Flickr, Summize and Twitter.
Vreetings is a video-plus-greetings service for creating video greeting cards using a drag-and-drop technique. The videos that you drag are YouTube videos.

Search and view Flickr photoset slideshows in cool 3D layouts: Cover Flow, Carousel, Grid, Spiral, Roller Coaster, and Time Machine. Powered by OpenFlux 3D, aka PlexiGlass. Includes large photo view, full screen mode, thumbnail strip and photo shuffling.
Display flickr photos for your Tivo
A slideshow of photos from Flickr. Show your photos or photos matching certain tags. Highly customizable with ability to change many display options. Uses Flickr and Widgetbox APIs.

Athenaeum is a mashup of Goodreads.com and Toronto Public Library created by Chris Nolan. Goodreads API allows to personalize book preferences, reason why the mashup can be found useful by members of the Toronto Public Library. Contents include how to use, tests, and known issues. Just like the author, users can automatically take checked out items and add them to Goodreads.com shelves.

This mashup feeds the semantic web service Calais every five minutes with the most recent tweets behind the current twitter trends in order to determine tags for these trends. With the resulting tag set at your fingertips.
UKBirdMap is a Google Map of bird sightings reported via Twitter. Tweets with the hashtag #ukbirdcount, a UK postcode and the species of bird spotted are automatically added to the map in real-time.
Mashup of Joomla, Amazon eCommerce, and NY Times Best Sellers.

SportShadow gives you check-in info for sports events. You can see who was at the game, read trends for different sports, even compare teams in the same sport. We follow where fans check-in so you can follow them, too. Come back often for fresh data and trends!
Dolphin Music Artists is a directory of musicians and the musical instruments they play. See which guitars and amps are used by the artists.
locfeed visualizes your facebook feed/stream in an interactive map
TextLang is a text message language translation service. Text a phrase and a desired language to translate to. You will receive a call back with the translation.
Just start typing and verses will be returned instantly.

This features the ecological datasets of the Partnership for Interdisciplinary Studies of Coastal Oceans. Users can pick an organism and see its distribution and abundance. Users can also view survey site metadata and species lists.
A Google Maps mashup that allows you to calculate the per-passenger greenhouse gas emissions created by a commercial airline flight between any two airports.
360 degree panoramas from around the Republic of Singapore, linked to a Google map of Singapore. Local information about each location appears, forming a virtual tour.
Use a Google Map to find NYC drink specials by neighborhood and day.

A hardware mashup that triggers an 85 dB smoke alarm when a matching news story is found on the live stream of articles from the New York Times NewsWire API. Built using the Processing development platform.
A quick and simple responsive developer portfolio theme for jekyll sites and GitHub Pages.
A local search mashup using your IP address to attempt to fix your position. Includes info about your IP address.

Fireflies is a web application that allows travelers to search for various traveling options and destinations domestically and internationally. The Allmyles API service has been integrated with this application.
A tool developed by the Nexmo community that will make it super easy to blast your SMS campaign from a simple Excel file.
This tool shows you restaurant ratings around your location. If you want to go beyond your normal lunch places, this is a great app.
Find a business broker visually using Google Maps.
YouTube search engine with results in RSS or JSON.
A map of the most expensive stadiums around the world.
Maps Hindu temples around the globe. Users can login and share temple information or click a temple to learn more about it.
Call In Studio is a call-in platform designed for internet and radio show producers. Allows producers to accept, manage and screen calls for shows in an easy-to-use web- based interface.
View radar and cloud cover superimposed on an animated Virtual Earth map. Adjust the degree of transparency for the weather data to see more or less of the underlying map.
A large and growing collection of Creative Commons animal photographs selected from Flickr.
Parkr! is an amusement parks and theme parks database that allows users to rate and comment on parks all over the world.

Weaves real-time, geographically matched user comments from Twitter that provide perspective on the temperature. Also integrates a clothing advisor to show you what people are wearing in your specified location. Link goes to Apple iTunes.

Customize a UK road trip, choose stop off points along the way - restaurants, cafes, petrol stations, child friendly venues - and also has an avoid motorways function. The route can be emailed and printed.
Automate your SEO reporting in Excel without programming.
Satellite images, information and directions for hundreds of stadiums across the United States.

A tool for Constant Contact users called ccQuick It's a great tool that allows you to create and configure subscribe boxes for your websites and then easily put the box on your site with a simple piece of code. Lead capture definitely just got easier!
ARSights is a Web-based tool for visualizing Google Earth 3D models using augmented reality.
iFixit iOS is a mobile application, a native iPad guide viewer built using iFixit's public APIs.

Tracegps.com lets you search and share your favorite outdoor trail by importing and exporting GPS data and Google mapping them. Use it to send files of your walk, bike ride or running trail or find a new hike or city tour nearby.
Visual search engine using Amazon Web services to search all discount deals on Amazon.com having at least 65% off.
Interactive Guide to the Ports and Mooring Places of the Upper Adriatic.
An app that uses SoundClouds API to play songs from the cloud on your profile. PHP source code available.
Hotel locations around the Monet garden in Giverny, France.
A way to explore all life forms in a taxonomic way. Useful for students, scientists and curious people. Flickr and GBIF (gbif.org) APIs.
Mashup of Google Maps and Rocky Mountain venture capital investments
An online diary for Twitter users. It's totally free. Track and rate your Moo'd Tweets...

This project was contributed by Andy Fundinger, a professional Python developer. Andy built this integration as a way to teach his students how to make calls to their mother's using Plivo and Raspberry Pi.
Twitter search results displayed and updated in a mosaic of pictures

Attractions of America lists top 10 attractions in each of the 50 States of America. Destinations include top beaches, top museums, top nightlife places, and top romantic destinations. The site shows the categories of things to do, US map, deals, and photos. Attractions of America invites users to add a favorite attraction at no cost with the aim to increase the number of adventures presented on the site.
An app for Windows Phone using Forvo API
This mashup is an app that will help you discover that new adventure or vacation through amazing photography from some of the most amazing photographers in the world.
Google Maps mashup for those wanting to discover new restaurants in a specific area.
Displays Amtrak rail routes and stations on Google Maps.
Compare traffic for up to five domains with this mashup of Alexa, Compete or Quantcast.

Mashup of Google Maps, Virtual Earth with many other APIs. Ext.js is used to make user interface intuitive. It lets you search for hotels, photos, restaurants, wifi spots, local news/blogs, events, weather, and many other spatial data.

Follow a long list of celebrities that actively use Twitter to communicate with their audiences. MC Hammer, Britney Spears, Eli Manning and Borat are just a few celebrities posting on a regular basis.
http://www.tatvic.com/adwords/index.php
Shop and instant message with your buddies at the same time. Uses jabber as the chat server.
A simple mashup showing interesting Flickr photos.
Allows you to create and play a quiz about geography using Google Maps.

iMapflickr.com allows non-techie users to create fully customizable embeddable google maps of geocoded flickr photosets or search results. You can use it to create maps of your own photos, or other users.
Visually see your twitter followers in a tree.
Find attractions on a map of Belize and other Central American cities. Click the tabs at the top to watch YouTube videos related to the city.
Mashup satellite images from BBC Weather and t7online. See the Instructions tab to see how to do it.

Phrasr is an interactive web based application that uses Flickr images to illustrate the phrases that users submit. You can choose every image and then publish the entire phrase, which is shown as a personal slide show.
Start a mailrace on a Google map.
Collection site where users can post things they collect, have, or want to trade. Uses RapLeaf as a feedback and reputation system.

Report power outages via SMS or email. This app triangulates the location of the outage and gives it to your power company. It's easier to report outages, utilities can repair them faster and you get status updates.
Click on two points on the NYC Google Map and the program will display the shortest subway route between those two points, including walking time.
This interactive map shows all of the member arts and cultural attractions in the Greater Louisville area.

FlowTest allows you to test OpenVBX Call Flows - as well as the text-to-speech engine - using the new OpenVBX Browser Phone. Instead of dialing in multiple times as you tweak your flows, you can can now test without even using your phone. When you start testing, the OpenVBX Browser Phone will ring, but once it's answered, you can continue to test different flows or the text-to-speech engine while the call is ongoing.
LookWho helps you meet new people in real places. Instantly learn who is in the same room or event.
Combines Flickr, Last.fm and YouTube. Create your own folders, drag your videos, and view videos in a player.
Using Voicecal, you have immediate access to your Google calendar just by making a phone call.

you tube streaming stations. Popularity and related category algorithms. Similar to youtube's play all feature, but does not require the time consuming process of setting up a youtube channel. search for a term, and watch away - no need to click every 45 to 90 seconds.
Google map of TB patient Andrew Speaker's journey across the Atlantic.
A real estate site for the Greek market.

The CoinDesk & Guardian News mashup merges Bitcoin prices and Guardian news headlines, showing them visually in a timeline. CoinDesk is a news site specializing in bitcoin and digital currencies. The Guardian is a British daily newspaper.

This is a tool for navigating the National Public Radio database, which is broken down in the form of Lists (Topics through Biographies). The data is presented as a sortable and clickable table. Text windows and audio are available...
Easy way for webmasters or others to geotag their site with geographic meta tags or their RSS feeds with geographic XML tags like GeoRSS.
Uses PHP and xslt to transform RSS feeds from Flickr into thumbnailed HTML pages. See demo and download code to run it on your own site.
Bilka.dk serves jobs, in-store events and location information on their stores. Bilka is a Danish chain of hypermarkets.
Video classifieds site that connects the local community and assists sellers and buyers in making transactions via videos.
Videos, photos, and panorama of Chile that helps tourists or others find restaurants, points of interest, banks, gas stations, and more in Chile.

Hotel mashups of Google Map, more then 30.000 hotels to locate on the map. View hotels on the map with Panoramic street view of the location where available. APIs used Hotel Club, Google Maps and Street Cities.
This tool shows the real-time position of Princess Cruises ships. Many ships feature a live webcam stream.
Breaking news as it happens via twitter.

IronBox is a service that protects data and secures privacy. Their IronBox Express is a web app that secures a user's DropBox account, ensuring file protection for all folder contents. IronBox enables privacy protected file sharing accompanied with notifications upon content usage. IronBox Express also offers customizable themes to match a company's branding.
Database of over 11,000 airfields and airports across the world, from major internationals like New York, Paris and London to more out-of the way airstrips like Antartica.
Using the Exchange Rate API and Ajax programming, the Currency Converter Ajax Application is an addon that can be installed on any website.
Calculates the distance between any 2 cities in the world and creates day routes between landmarks for major cities.
Allows Box.net users to share content directly from their Box accounts to their Facebook accounts.
Find hotels, real estate, and businesses in Greece.
Simple Amazon search interface that filters items to show only things eligible for Amazon Prime free shipping.
The Consolidated Screening List (CSL) is a list of parties for which the United States Government maintains restrictions on certain exports, re-exports or transfers of items.
Real-time visualizations of the stream of information flowing into Flickr. View photos, tags or buddy icons as they are active on the site.

Music Updated helps you stay up to date with the music you like. It's like a twitter newsfeed, but dedicated to music news and upcoming albums based on the artists you follow. It acquires some of this information by leveraging the Last.fm and YouTube APIs.
Sportmeets connects online users who love sports so that they can meet, organize their teams and events and compete offline.

CameraPrices reviews, ratings, prices on 1000s of camera products. Browse the directory to find the best deals and cheapest prices. Check out the blog, polls, news, articles, and photography community for more camera information.
Using Google Maps API plus Google KML API to render my blog in a Geo context.

Newstaggr is a new way for browsing news. It gathers news from sources like Reuters, CNN, New York Times, and BBC, and it uses Calais to semantically tag them and create a tag cloud for 12 categories.
See when the next streetcars are coming (Toronto) and watch them move on a map in real time. Desktop and mobile friendly.
Facebook app that allows Tour and Activity Operators using TourCMS to easily add their product details to a new tab on their Facebook page.
World Travel Guide featuring Video and pictures of, hotels, resorts and restaurants on an interactive Google Map.
Returns an RSS feed from Google containing the latest news about your favourite artists, as listed in your Last.fm profile.
Instant portfolio assembly on iGoogle
This map shows the location of startups around Austin, Texas. This map includes: Startups, Accelerators, Incubators, Coworking, Investors, Consulting, and Events locations.
TumblRSS lets you import content from RSS Feeds into Tumblr.
This mashup plots the microfinance loans from Kiva lenders on a Google Map. Popups show details on the individual loans and borrowers.
A bookmarklet makes easier to design your twitter theme.

Any statement or challenge can make a journey around the world. Google Maps makes this beautifully visible. Anything you come up with can be followed by thousands of people by creating your own viral.
Offers billing software for creating or modifying invoice reports and provides IE password recovery. Uses the US Postal Service API.
A community-style Google Maps mashup that lets location evangelists own their favorite places in virtual terms, showcase them, share their thoughts and shape the discussion.
Fun mapping based puzzle built by Google using the Google Earth API.

Mix YouTube, Google Video and other video sharing services videos into one channel. Create your own TV channel. Watch pre-defined channels and the hottest ones from the aggregated sites. Video search.

A social rating and review site for iPhone, Google Android, and Nokia apps. Allows users to post their apps, YouTube videos, screenshots, and descriptions. A great way for developers to promote their apps.
A Twitter Trends dashboard that, at a glance, shows you whatâ€™s happening across geographyâ€™s using trending topics on Twitter.
Interactive map to see where the many Madoff pyramid scheme victims live.
This real estate plug-in allows you to join a network of real estate web blogs who are growing their traffic through real estate Q&A.
Real time travel information for Leeds, UK.
Nationwide map listing thousands of garage sales pulled from Craigslist and its own users. All sales take place within the next two weeks.
If you are interested in the game business, you can use the GCDB searching and mapping tools to find companies near you.
A tool for reverse IP lookup. This site's language is Turkish.

The GET DigitalHealth mashup enables a clinical trial sponsor, clinical research organization or an academic researcher/investigators to set up a study, select wearables/devices and start receiving data from study participants. Participants have to click on an invite link, sign the consent, and provide authorization for the device data to be accessed by Get DigitalHealth. The platform provides study teams the ability to export data to a spreadsheet, visualize or directly push data to clinical trial management systems such as the Medidata and OpenClinical. The mashup features insightful analytics, HIPAA compliant security, normalized, intelligent data retrieval, intergration with EHR and CTMS, and more.
Thelaw.tv now has a click-to-call button to call a lawyer immediately from their website using Twilio Client.
Lists recent tweets about Amazon.com products from the Twitter public timeline.

Corobot checks tasks from your cohuman (www.cohuman.com) workspace and does them for you - and let's you and your team know when each task is complete. Corobot is available in two products: Corobot Companion is an intelligent automaton who lives within Cohuman (cohuman.com). He's there to help 24/7 with any cohuman-based project - just invite him in and put him to work!
